documents.title: Evolving APIs
documents.selectionRationale: Primary guidance for additive changes to an existing versioned ARM API and the version applicability of the new promotion option.

guidance.excerpt:
You can add new models, properties, or operations in a specific version and all subsequent versions using the `@added` decorator.

*   The `version` argument is the version where the element is introduced.
*   The element will be present in that version and all later versions.

documents.title: Versioning overview
documents.selectionRationale: Version enum ordering and active-preview rules govern the new preview after the latest stable ARM API.

guidance.section: Preview Versioning Rules for All Azure APIs
guidance.excerpt:
*   Always make the last enum value the preview and apply `@previewVersion` to it.
*   Only one version may be marked with the `@previewVersion` decorator.
*   Mark all changes from the latest stable with appropriate versioning decorators, using `Versions.<PreviewVersion>` as the version argument (where `<PreviewVersion>` is the name of the last enum value)

intentAssessments.actual: The complete added member is a documentation comment followed by v2026_06_15_preview: "2026-06-15-preview"; no @previewVersion decorator is added.
intentAssessments.rationale: Both the general preview rules and the directly matching stable-to-preview instructions require the decorator. applicableGuidance.guidanceSection: Preview Versioning Rules for All Azure APIs
applicableGuidance.excerpt:
*   Always make the last enum value the preview and apply `@previewVersion` to it.
*   Only one version may be marked with the `@previewVersion` decorator.
*   Mark all changes from the latest stable with appropriate versioning decorators, using `Versions.<PreviewVersion>` as the version argument (where `<PreviewVersion>` is the name of the last enum value)
